data.name: Neji Hyūga
data.description:
His name is Neji hyūga, he is 18 years old, his height: 172.1 cm, his weight: 54.2 kg, Blood type: O, his Kekkei Genkai: Byakugan, Affiliation: Konohagakure and Allied Shinobi Forces.

Neji Hyuga (日向ネジ, Hyuuga Neji ) was a member of the Hyuga clan and a shinobi of Konohagakure . Although a prodigy even by Hyuga standards, Neji was a member of the branch house; as such, no matter how skilled he became, he would always be in service to the Hyuga main house, a fact that convinced him that destiny was predetermined. After seeing Naruto Uzumaki 's refusal to be bound by an ideology like this, Neji realised that his destiny was the one he chose for himself, and as a member of Team Guy , he sought the strength needed to make the future he wanted for his family and friends.

Neji was extremely serious and mature for his age, and had great control over his emotions. Before and during the Chuunin Exams and his fight with Naruto, he was cold, and somewhat arrogant. In his younger years, Neji was a kind, more optimistic child who smiled more often. He even told his father that he found Hinata "cute" when the two branches of the Hyuga clan gathered for his third birthday. [6]

While under the belief that his father had died because he was a member of the branch house, Neji concluded that fate is something decided at birth and that no matter what one does, people cannot escape their destiny. Neji applied this often to people he considered to be weaker than him, such as his cousin, Hinata . During their fight in the Chuunin Exams preliminaries, Neji told Hinata that she was unfit to be a ninja, due to being too kind and not having enough confidence. When she was finally able to turn his philosophy against him, telling him that she believed he was suffering by trying to become worthy of the main house despite being born into the branch house, Neji became enraged, and attempted to attack Hinata. He was stopped by the jounin present, but Hinata, however, was left in a critical condition due to his earlier attacks.

Neji displayed similar efforts to express his philosophy during his fight with Naruto Uzumaki who, despite being repeatedly struck by him, continued to try and fight him. Although Neji tried to show Naruto that fate cannot be fought, and that someone who is weak will always remain weak, Naruto was unwilling to accept this mindset, arguing that Neji, for all his belief in fate, does not accept his own fate. After Naruto defeated Neji, he suggested that if a "failure" like him could change his fate, he thought a "genius" like Neji could do the same. From this experience, Neji came to see Naruto's ability to save people from "darkness" and believed that he could save anyone, since Naruto saved him from his "darkness".

With this example of overcoming "fate", as well as learning the truth about his father's death soon after, Neji abandoned the concept of inescapable fate. No longer bound by the idea that he was trapped in his current state, Neji resolved to become strong enough to never lose in battle again. To do this, he began to place more emphasis on working well with his team and began to value the successful completion of a mission and the safety of his teammates over his own betterment, even encouraging Rock Lee to continue pursuing his own dream. His abandonment of the concept of inescapable fate was most prominent during his fight with Kidoumaru , where, despite the Oto ninja knowing the Byakugan's weakness and Neji being severely injured, he was still able to fight and eventually defeat Kidoumaru because he remembered what Naruto had told him.

Neji abandoned the bandages and wore the traditional Hyūga attire: a white shirt with loose sleeves, fastened at the right shoulder, with a zipper running down the right side of the chest, matching pants, with a dark navy grey apron tied around the waist, and black shinobi sandals. This may or may not have been used to facilitate the execution of his techniques, or to symbolise his close relations with his clan. Neji usually carried a large, tan and black drawstring bag, which he carried over his shoulders. During the Fourth Shinobi World War, he wore the standard Konohagakure attire with a flak jacket , and Alliance forehead protector.

In the early part of the series, Neji's facial expression was generally stern, hard, and cold. As the series progressed, however, his expression relaxed. He even smiled and laughed at times. While still composed, Neji appeared to be calmer, confident, and mature, rather than defiant.

Neji was born without a seal on his forehead, but when his cousin Hinata Hyuuga (heiress of the main family) turned three, he was branded with the Hyuuga main family's Juinjutsu by his uncle Hiashi Hyuuga . All members of the branch family bear this curse mark, as it is a symbol that one lives only to serve the main family.

Neji's father, Hizashi Hyuga , was well aware of Neji's natural talent, and he was frustrated that despite Neji's skill, Neji still carried the lot of a servant. Hizashi openly displayed his anger, and consequently, he was punished by having Hiashi activate his cursed seal. By this time, Konohagakure and Kumogakure had signed a treaty of alliance. However, this treaty only served as a ticket into Konoha and a reduction in Konoha's guard so that Kumogakure's Head Ninja could kidnap Hinata and steal the secrets of the Byakugan . The attempt failed, though, as Hiashi intervened and killed the Kumogakure ninja.

When news of the assassination reached Kumogakure, they demanded Hiashi's body as compensation (as his body would hold the Byakugan as well). Konoha was unprepared to comply with this request, until Hizashi intervened and offered to surrender himself in his place. Because he was bound by the main family's juinjutsu when he died, the Byakugan would be sealed. Hizashi willingly made this sacrifice in order to protect his brother, family, and the village. However, Neji came to believe that the main family had forced him to do it. This misconception became the main basis of his grudge against the main family and his concrete view of his own unchangeable destiny.

A year before the start of the series, Neji graduated at the top of his class, and was placed on Team Guy , with Might Guy as the Jounin leader , and Rock Lee and Tenten as his teammates. After officially being promoted to the rank of genin, Neji refused to reveal his dream, and laughed when Rock Lee stated that he could become a great ninja with just taijutsu . During his first year on Team Guy, Lee challenged Neji many times, but always lost. Guy decided to have his team wait a year before taking the Chuunin Exams, in order to ensure that they were prepared. At some point before his first Chuunin Exams, his animosity towards the main family became evident to Guy, who made him promise not to let the issue influence his feelings during the Chuunin Exams.

From a young age, Neji had been hailed as a natural genius, even among the Hyuga clan. He was labelled as the top ranked rookie in his class, and was said by Lee to be the strongest genin to participate in the Chuunin Exams in Part I. His father stated that with his talent, he could potentially surpass all other members of his clan In the mission to retrieve Sasuke from the Sound Four , Neji proved capable of killing Kidoumaru , a very capable subordinate of Orochimaru . During the time gap, while most of the former genin of the Konoha 11 had achieved the rank of chuunin , Neji was the only one to advance to the rank of jounin , demonstrating his strength by destroying three of Kisame Hoshigaki 's water clones after breaking his Water Prison Technique . Additionally, he is said to have surpassed all other members of the Hyuga clan, including his uncle.

Taijutsu
As a member of the Hyuga clan, Neji specialized in close-range taijutsu combat . In battle, Neji displayed great agility and dexterity, being able to simultaneously dodge and attack an opponent with no wasted movement. His attacks were fast and fluid, precisely timed in rapid succession to leave very little time for his opponent to find an opening to counterattack.

Neji's fighting style was his clan's signature style, the Gentle Fist , which takes advantage of the Byakugan's ability to see people's chakra networks . The Gentle Fist allows one to cause severe internal trauma with minimal external force, as it relies on the surgical injection of chakra into an opponent's chakra network. Because Neji's Byakugan was stronger than most, he was able to see special points in the chakra network, called tenketsu , with this, Neji could use the Gentle Fist to not only damage opponents, but control their chakra flow as well. Using the Gentle Fist, Neji could affect internal organs, and was able to kill an opponent with a single strike by striking the heart. Training in the Gentle Fist style entails increased regulatory control of chakra and mastery of the human chakra network. As a result, Neji could eject chakra from any tenketsu in his body as a means to slow or prevent himself from being hit by projectiles. He could also free himself from chakra-based substances using this technique. By continuously maintaining this chakra expulsion, Neji could create a quasi-sensory barrier around himself to detect anything that entered its area, thus protecting the Byakugan's blind spot, though it quickly depleted his chakra reserves, as seen when he used this tactic against Kidoumaru. Now Neji protects Hinata Hyūga and they both act like "brothers"
